I have a question regarding taxi cabs in Chicago. Is it allowable to tranport drunk passengers? Let me explain you the situation here: During morning shifts(5Am to 5PM) the passengers are mostly those going to office, airport or shopping malls. But during evening shifts, customers are mostly going to Bars/Pubs/strip clubs. There are certain streets which have bars one after the other. Going on those streets means you are going near bars. Also cabbies line up outside famous bars/pubs. If you want to avoid these customers you have to take small streets where you are almost certain of not getting any customers. Then to pick up customers you have to go to office areas which will be very far. After 11PM there is hardly anyone else on the streets other than drunk revelers. Another issue you can consider is that if anyone is trying to flag you down, you cannot refuse them. But that is just a rule and can be conveniently broken. In short avoiding bar areas is feasible but you make 1/3rd of what other people make. 2137 views Q. Kya admission ke liye commission dene jaiyz hai? 1968 views Q. answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 48395 Country: Bangladesh Title: Job in Stock Exchange and its salary Question: I am working in a Dhaka Stock Exchange as an Engineer. I want to know whether my job in Stock exchange is Halal or Haram. Is my salary Halal? Answer ID: 48395 Posted on: Dec 18, 2023 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1425/978/L=11/1434) If you are working only as an Engineer and you do not have any share in the business, then your job as well your salary thereof is lawful. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
